evidence.cloud_mcp: Official Webull Cloud MCP expansion announced 2026-09-29; hosted MCP exposes real-time/historical market data plus account balances, positions and order history to authorized AI assistants.
evidence.least_privilege: Official Cloud MCP capability groups separately authorize Account Infos, Order Query, Market Data and Security Master.
evidence.automation: Webull CLI/Cloud MCP explicitly supports scripts, scheduled jobs and AI-driven tooling.
evidence.jurisdiction: Official Webull Financial account policy requires U.S. residency/accepted U.S. visa; Webull states it does not open or maintain accounts for individuals residing outside the United States.
evidence.consumer_nbbo: Consumer offering has NBBO products, but full continuous National NBBO is fee-bearing and free per-query/display availability does not prove strict automated Cloud-MCP/OpenAPI entitlement.
evidence.openapi_marketdata: OpenAPI market-data entitlement is separate from consumer app entitlements.

reopen_condition: Only reopen if Webull Financial officially supports Türkiye-resident individual accounts and grants the exact scheduler-callable consolidated NBBO+trade event feed at permanent $0 with lawful automated/non-display rights.
